At MJS Packaging, our packaging experts help you push your product beyond the concept stage and into
consumers’ hands as expediently and efficiently as possible. We aim to alleviate the pressure in
this process while keeping your convenience and profit maximization an upmost priority.


#### Testimonials

MJS Packaging has long-standing relationships with packaging manufacturers who offer a variety of
technologies and capabilities. - Kevin R., Pharmaceutical Manufacturer

excellent work ethic and competitive pricing. - Pat P., Chemical Manufacturer
Their ability to warehouse product limits our material shortages. Add to that the wealth of
knowledge possessed by the team, and we have the recipe for a successful partnership. - Regina D.,

and technical support. - Bridget P., Pharmaceutical Manufacturer

and quotes to expert advice. - Joe G., Food Manufacturer

## We are Novolex

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging servicing customers
across a wide range of industries, including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food
processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors.

With an extensive and innovative product portfolio, we help businesses operate efficiently, meet
evolving customer expectations, and deliver everyday essentials to millions of consumers around the
world.

## Join our team

At Novolex, our people are at the heart of Packaging for a Better Future through choice, innovation,
and sustainability. We offer opportunities to grow, learn, and contribute in meaningful ways across
our manufacturing facilities, offices, and distribution centers. Explore our open roles and see how
you can be part of our growing organization.

[ View Jobs ][26]

## Community

As a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging, Novolex is uniquely positioned
to help address food insecurity and support the communities where we live and work. Our company-wide
Month of Action is one way we empower our teams to give back. Through local volunteer efforts and
charitable contributions, employees support the organizations and causes that matter most to them
and their families.

[ Learn More ][27]

## Choice, Innovation, & Sustainability

[Product Choices for Your Business Needs]

### Product Choices for Your Business Needs

Novolex offers one of the industry’s broadest portfolios of packaging solutions designed to
safeguard, preserve, and showcase food and beverages for customers across diverse markets.

[ View Products ][28]
[ Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers]

### Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers

As market needs evolve, Novolex provides material and product choices that support performance,
sustainability, and speed-to-market. Our teams of material scientists and engineers enable us to
help customers transition to more sustainable alternatives efficiently and effectively.

[Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet]

### Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet

We fulfill the Novolex promise of choice, innovation and sustainability beginning with the materials
we select. Over time, we have expanded the diversity of substrates used across our product lines to
meet both functional requirements and customer sustainability goals.

## 30-plus years of plastic packaging production experience

Pac-Lite manufactures and designs plastic bottles, jars, and closures for consumer goods markets.
The company began in 1991 by manufacturing plastic vials and closures for prescription drug
pharmacies dispensing under the Pharmacy-Lite brand name.

In 2022, management contemplated a widespread economic downturn and decided to broaden our business
model to include plastic packaging for consumer goods, which dovetail nicely with our 30-plus years
of plastic packaging production experience.

Pac-Lite has since accumulated world-class injection molding, injection stretch blow molding, and
closure lining equipment. Initial stock product lines include biodegradable wide-mouth jars and
stock closures.

## We are Novolex

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging servicing customers
across a wide range of industries, including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food
processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors.

With an extensive and innovative product portfolio, we help businesses operate efficiently, meet
evolving customer expectations, and deliver everyday essentials to millions of consumers around the
world.

## Join our team

At Novolex, our people are at the heart of Packaging for a Better Future through choice, innovation,
and sustainability. We offer opportunities to grow, learn, and contribute in meaningful ways across
our manufacturing facilities, offices, and distribution centers. Explore our open roles and see how
you can be part of our growing organization.

[ View Jobs ][26]

## Community

As a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging, Novolex is uniquely positioned
to help address food insecurity and support the communities where we live and work. Our company-wide
Month of Action is one way we empower our teams to give back. Through local volunteer efforts and
charitable contributions, employees support the organizations and causes that matter most to them
and their families.

## We are Novolex

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging servicing customers
across a wide range of industries, including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food
processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors.

With an extensive and innovative product portfolio, we help businesses operate efficiently, meet
evolving customer expectations, and deliver everyday essentials to millions of consumers around the
world.

## Join our team

At Novolex, our people are at the heart of Packaging for a Better Future through choice, innovation,
and sustainability. We offer opportunities to grow, learn, and contribute in meaningful ways across
our manufacturing facilities, offices, and distribution centers. Explore our open roles and see how
you can be part of our growing organization.

[ View Jobs ][26]

## Community

As a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging, Novolex is uniquely positioned
to help address food insecurity and support the communities where we live and work. Our company-wide
Month of Action is one way we empower our teams to give back. Through local volunteer efforts and
charitable contributions, employees support the organizations and causes that matter most to them
and their families.

[ Learn More ][27]

## Choice, Innovation, & Sustainability

[Product Choices for Your Business Needs]

### Product Choices for Your Business Needs

Novolex offers one of the industry’s broadest portfolios of packaging solutions designed to
safeguard, preserve, and showcase food and beverages for customers across diverse markets.

[ View Products ][28]
[ Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers]

### Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers

As market needs evolve, Novolex provides material and product choices that support performance,
sustainability, and speed-to-market. Our teams of material scientists and engineers enable us to
help customers transition to more sustainable alternatives efficiently and effectively.

[Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet]

### Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet

We fulfill the Novolex promise of choice, innovation and sustainability beginning with the materials
we select. Over time, we have expanded the diversity of substrates used across our product lines to
meet both functional requirements and customer sustainability goals.

#### The Packaging Maestro

At Adeneli Packaging, you’re in the right place to get everything done — expertly. We don’t just
manage packaging; we orchestrate it. From concept to completion, our team delivers results that are
more than the sum of the parts.

#### [Where Packaging Meets Payback - ROI][18]

We’ll show you exactly how quickly your investment pays for itself — and we’ll work alongside you to
make sure those returns come even faster because great packaging doesn’t just look good, it
performs.

[][19]

#### [Packaging Reimagined — Your One Stop Shop][20]

Solutions designed to elevate client interactions, streamline the sign-up process, and deliver clear
metrics—that show exactly how your packaging is performing and contributing to your business growth.

#### Seamless Packaging, From Start to Finish

Our expert team managing every detail, you experience packaging solutions that work together
seamlessly, so your business can focus on growth while we handle the logistics, quality, and
execution.

# Plastics Manufacturing Solutions
# To Help Enhance and Extend Lives

### Comar is a contract manufacturing partner for healthcare companies worldwide and a leading
### provider of primary packaging and dispensing products. Through a distinct blend of fresh
### thinking, engineering edge, and customer focus, we bring transformative plastic solutions from
### concept to reality, where they can positively impact the world around us.

[cleanroom technician working on machine]

## UNIQUE SET OF **MOLDING TECHNOLOGIES**

Our unmatched toolkit of molding technologies enables us to create products and components in a wide
range of materials, shapes, sizes, and tolerances. Our capabilities include injection molding,
injection blow molding, extrusion blow molding, and injection stretch blow molding.

[**View Molding Technologies**][124]

[map of comar locations higlighted]

## COAST-TO-COAST **COVERAGE**

Our network of manufacturing and engineering facilities is strategically distributed to be close to
you and your supply chain partners. With our continuous expansion of plants, capabilities, and
teams, we are well-positioned to support your current needs and future growth. Proximity means local
relationships, reduced transportation costs, just-in-time deliveries, and a partner you can interact
with face-to-face.

**[View Locations][125]**

 

[man working on whiteboard]

## CONCEPT TO **COMMERCIALIZATION**

Our process begins with obtaining an in-depth understanding of your strategy and objectives to
set the foundation for mutual success. With Innovation & Design Center teams that are ready to
assist with custom design and product development, we partner with you to work as one team to move
quickly from concept to commercialization.

[**View Design Services**][126]

[Two hands shaking]

## SOLUTION-ORIENTED **EXPERTISE**

We have earned a reputation as a partner you can rely on. Our 75 years of experience have
consistently focused on solving ever more complex issues in the medical and healthcare markets.
Building on a foundation of hard-earned trust and unwavering quality standards, we respond to
manufacturing challenges and regulatory hurdles with creative solutions and robust processes to keep
you on track and on time.

[**Explore Partnering With Us**][127]

Join an energetic, collaborative workplace that fosters camaraderie, innovation, and exceptional
service, where we celebrate individual creativity and initiative, advance aspirations, and protect
health and well-being.

[Explore Careers][128]

For 75 years, we have partnered with our clients to launch high-impact packaging and medical
solutions—transforming them from concept to reality, where they can positively impact the world
around us.

homeware and lifestyle products, and seamlessly connect global brands with MENA retailers and
consumers

# The art of first impressions.

Bespoke luxury packaging for premium brands, crafted end to end. The first thing your customer
touches — made to be remembered.

[Start a project][8][Explore the collection→][9]

House Notes

## Packaging worthy of the brand it carries.

Luxel Pac is a custom luxury packaging manufacturer and partner to leading brands. We handle design,
development and production end to end — every project overseen by our own team, from material
selection to the final edge finish, in FSC- and ISO-certified facilities. A decade in the industry
sits behind every project.

We work with fragrance, jewellery, beauty, fashion and confectionery brands, and the gifting houses
behind them. As sustainability becomes central to luxury packaging, recyclable, responsibly-sourced
and low-impact materials run throughout the collection.

Minimum orderFrom 1,000 units
Production sitesFSC & ISO-certified
DeliveryWorldwide
QualityPer-batch QC

The Craft

## You hold the box before a single press runs.

Four movements, from the first conversation to delivery — managed end to end.
1. 01
   
   ### Discovery
   
   We begin in conversation with your brand — listening for tone, ritual, audience, and where the
   packaging sits in the buyer’s moment.
   
   Response within 48 hours
2. 02
   
   ### Sampling
   
   Working with structural and material specialists, we develop physical samples to your brief —
   refined until the structure, weight, and finish are right.
   
   Physical samples in 2–3 weeks
3. 03
   
   ### Production
   
   Offset, foil, deboss, fold, and finish are produced to our QC protocol in our certified
   facilities. Every batch is checked before it leaves the floor.
   
   Documented QC, every batch
4. 04
   
   ### Delivery
   
   We coordinate freight and the warehouse handoff, so your packaging arrives ready for the
   fulfilment line.
   
   Worldwide delivery

Materials & Provenance

## Luxury and responsibility, no longer separable.

Our sustainable line uses moulded pulp formed without plastic, recycled and recyclable boards, and
food-safe plant-based inks — built for composting or recycling at end of life. Production runs in
FSC- and ISO-certified facilities, with provenance documentation available per order on request.
* FSC chain-of-custody stocksAvailable on request
* Recycled & recyclable boardsAcross the sustainable line
* Plant-based, food-safe inksSoy and water-based options
* Compostable optionsIndustrially compostable to EN 13432 where specified

Get in touch

## Let's talk.

Tell us about your project and we'll respond within one business day — a considered reply, not a
templated quote.

## 30-plus years of plastic packaging production experience

Pac-Lite manufactures and designs plastic bottles, jars, and closures for consumer goods markets.
The company began in 1991 by manufacturing plastic vials and closures for prescription drug
pharmacies dispensing under the Pharmacy-Lite brand name.

In 2022, management contemplated a widespread economic downturn and decided to broaden our business
model to include plastic packaging for consumer goods, which dovetail nicely with our 30-plus years
of plastic packaging production experience.

Pac-Lite has since accumulated world-class injection molding, injection stretch blow molding, and
closure lining equipment. Initial stock product lines include biodegradable wide-mouth jars and
stock closures.

## Blog & Announcements

### [What the Woods Taught Me About Our Plastic Problem][20]

Our family recently ventured to the Georgia mountains for a few days of fresh air, open skies, and
the kind of slow, unhurried time together that has become increasingly rare in modern life.

### [Why Choosing Biodegradable Plastic Containers Matters: A Greener Future with PAC-Lite][21]

In a world increasingly impacted by plastic pollution and environmental degradation, the packaging
choices we make today matter more than ever.

## Who We Are

At Silgan Plastics, we’re passionate about solving problems. We specialize in manufacturing custom
packaging solutions to fit the unique needs of markets ranging from personal care to food storage.
We have multiple Commercial Development Centers across North America staffed with experienced
product engineers and cutting edge molding technology. From market and product research to
conceptual design and patenting, Silgan Plastics can help boost your brand and take your packaging
to the next level.

[Learn More][60]

### Product Solutions

We pride ourselves on delivering innovative solutions for all your plastic manufacturing needs.
Whether you seek one of our existing designs or a custom packaging solution, our team of experts is
here to help. Explore our wide range of offerings and discover how Silgan Plastics can help your
business thrive in today’s market.

The success of Silgan Plastics is driven by **your** packaging needs. We embrace challenges that
make us think outside the box and create new product solutions. We’ve invested our time and money
into cutting-edge molding technologies that allow us to cater to unique industry requirements.

At Silgan Plastics, we aim to drive the industry forward with enhanced production, product quality
and sustainability.

From collaborating with you on the shape of your plastic packaging to customizing it with your

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

Sun Chemical develops a wide range of [pigments and color materials][119] for architectural,
automotive and industrial coatings, cosmetics, plastics, printing inks, agricultural, and more.

value for coatings formulators.

Sun Chemical and DIC produce a variety of [advanced materials][121], including liquid compounds,
solid compounds and application materials for printed circuits, printed electronics, solar modules,
digital inkjet printing, automotive components, adhesives, magnetic tapes for plastic cards and
degasification modules.

providing a wide-range of high-quality security solutions to help protect your products from
counterfeiters.

by 2050][125], we are reducing global CO2 emissions by increasing the use of bio-renewable and
recyclable materials, while promoting the value of these activities throughout the supply chain. Our
emphasis on sustainability continues to be fundamental to our innovation and product development and
is gaining broad support from our customers.

## [Frequently Asked Questions][136]

#### How long will it take to receive my order?

95% of all orders are handed over to our shipping & logistics partners the very next working day
(within 24 hrs). Custom printed orders take an additional 3 days for artwork approval and CTP/plate
making. Majority of our orders are delivered within 2 days after shipment via Blue Dart, Delhivery,
India Post, etc. Remote locations and ones affected by lockdown may take longer.

#### What is your price for a bulk quantity order?

Please e-mail your request to sales@upack.in and we will be happy to provide a bulk quotation for
packaging materials, customised boxes, carton boxes, packing tapes, bubble roll, stretch film, etc.

#### Can you sell to individual customers or just to companies?

Although most of our sales are business to business, we can sell to any type of customer.

#### What other payment options?

You may use all major credit cards, net banking, UPI, etc. U-Pack’s payment gateway partners are
PCI/DSS certified to keep your transaction details confidential at all times.

# ALPLA is a world leader in the development and production of innovative plastic packaging
# solutions.

We produce innovative packaging systems, bottles, caps and injection-moulded parts for a wide range
of industries since 1955. Our long history as a family-run business, our cutting-edge technologies
and the knowledge and dedication of our employees set us and our products apart. Our business
activities are founded on sustainability and the climate-friendly use of resources. With our more
than 30 years of experience in recycling and our own recycling plants, we play our part in ensuring
that plastics remain in the materials cycle.

# ALPLA is a world leader in the development and production of innovative plastic packaging
# solutions.

We produce innovative packaging systems, bottles, caps and injection-moulded parts for a wide range
of industries since 1955. Our long history as a family-run business, our cutting-edge technologies
and the knowledge and dedication of our employees set us and our products apart. Our business
activities are founded on sustainability and the climate-friendly use of resources. With our more
than 30 years of experience in recycling and our own recycling plants, we play our part in ensuring
that plastics remain in the materials cycle.

# Plastics Manufacturing Solutions
# To Help Enhance and Extend Lives

### Comar is a contract manufacturing partner for healthcare companies worldwide and a leading
### provider of primary packaging and dispensing products. Through a distinct blend of fresh
### thinking, engineering edge, and customer focus, we bring transformative plastic solutions from
### concept to reality, where they can positively impact the world around us.

[cleanroom technician working on machine]

## UNIQUE SET OF **MOLDING TECHNOLOGIES**

Our unmatched toolkit of molding technologies enables us to create products and components in a wide
range of materials, shapes, sizes, and tolerances. Our capabilities include injection molding,
injection blow molding, extrusion blow molding, and injection stretch blow molding.

[**View Molding Technologies**][124]

[map of comar locations higlighted]

## COAST-TO-COAST **COVERAGE**

Our network of manufacturing and engineering facilities is strategically distributed to be close to
you and your supply chain partners. With our continuous expansion of plants, capabilities, and
teams, we are well-positioned to support your current needs and future growth. Proximity means local
relationships, reduced transportation costs, just-in-time deliveries, and a partner you can interact
with face-to-face.

**[View Locations][125]**

 

[man working on whiteboard]

## CONCEPT TO **COMMERCIALIZATION**

Our process begins with obtaining an in-depth understanding of your strategy and objectives to
set the foundation for mutual success. With Innovation & Design Center teams that are ready to
assist with custom design and product development, we partner with you to work as one team to move
quickly from concept to commercialization.

[**View Design Services**][126]

[Two hands shaking]

## SOLUTION-ORIENTED **EXPERTISE**

We have earned a reputation as a partner you can rely on. Our 75 years of experience have
consistently focused on solving ever more complex issues in the medical and healthcare markets.
Building on a foundation of hard-earned trust and unwavering quality standards, we respond to
manufacturing challenges and regulatory hurdles with creative solutions and robust processes to keep
you on track and on time.

[**Explore Partnering With Us**][127]

Join an energetic, collaborative workplace that fosters camaraderie, innovation, and exceptional
service, where we celebrate individual creativity and initiative, advance aspirations, and protect
health and well-being.

[Explore Careers][128]

solutions—transforming them from concept to reality, where they can positively impact the world
around us.

packaging][170] industry.

# The art of first impressions.

Bespoke luxury packaging for premium brands, crafted end to end. The first thing your customer
touches — made to be remembered.

[Start a project][8][Explore the collection→][9]

House Notes

## Packaging worthy of the brand it carries.

Luxel Pac is a custom luxury packaging manufacturer and partner to leading brands. We handle design,
development and production end to end — every project overseen by our own team, from material
selection to the final edge finish, in FSC- and ISO-certified facilities. A decade in the industry
sits behind every project.

We work with fragrance, jewellery, beauty, fashion and confectionery brands, and the gifting houses
behind them. As sustainability becomes central to luxury packaging, recyclable, responsibly-sourced
and low-impact materials run throughout the collection.

Minimum orderFrom 1,000 units
Production sitesFSC & ISO-certified
DeliveryWorldwide
QualityPer-batch QC

Each family is a starting point. Every material, structure, and finish is open to your

The Craft

## You hold the box before a single press runs.

Four movements, from the first conversation to delivery — managed end to end.
1. 01
   
   ### Discovery
   
   We begin in conversation with your brand — listening for tone, ritual, audience, and where the
   packaging sits in the buyer’s moment.
   
   Response within 48 hours
2. 02
   
   ### Sampling
   
   Working with structural and material specialists, we develop physical samples to your brief —
   refined until the structure, weight, and finish are right.
   
   Physical samples in 2–3 weeks
3. 03
   
   ### Production
   
   Offset, foil, deboss, fold, and finish are produced to our QC protocol in our certified
   facilities. Every batch is checked before it leaves the floor.
   
   Documented QC, every batch
4. 04
   
   ### Delivery
   
   We coordinate freight and the warehouse handoff, so your packaging arrives ready for the
   fulfilment line.
   
   Worldwide delivery

Materials & Provenance

## Luxury and responsibility, no longer separable.

Our sustainable line uses moulded pulp formed without plastic, recycled and recyclable boards, and
food-safe plant-based inks — built for composting or recycling at end of life. Production runs in
FSC- and ISO-certified facilities, with provenance documentation available per order on request.
* FSC chain-of-custody stocksAvailable on request
* Recycled & recyclable boardsAcross the sustainable line
* Plant-based, food-safe inksSoy and water-based options
* Compostable optionsIndustrially compostable to EN 13432 where specified

Get in touch

## Let's talk.

Tell us about your project and we'll respond within one business day — a considered reply, not a
templated quote.

## Who We Are

At Silgan Plastics, we’re passionate about solving problems. We specialize in manufacturing custom
packaging solutions to fit the unique needs of markets ranging from personal care to food storage.
We have multiple Commercial Development Centers across North America staffed with experienced
product engineers and cutting edge molding technology. From market and product research to
conceptual design and patenting, Silgan Plastics can help boost your brand and take your packaging
to the next level.

[Learn More][60]

### Product Solutions

We pride ourselves on delivering innovative solutions for all your plastic manufacturing needs.
Whether you seek one of our existing designs or a custom packaging solution, our team of experts is
here to help. Explore our wide range of offerings and discover how Silgan Plastics can help your
business thrive in today’s market.

The success of Silgan Plastics is driven by **your** packaging needs. We embrace challenges that
make us think outside the box and create new product solutions. We’ve invested our time and money
into cutting-edge molding technologies that allow us to cater to unique industry requirements.

At Silgan Plastics, we aim to drive the industry forward with enhanced production, product quality
and sustainability.

[Learn More][63]

From collaborating with you on the shape of your plastic packaging to customizing it with your

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

Execute with confidence and measure the effect on growth, margin and resilience.

## Our Core Capabilities

### End-to-End intelligence and advisory across industries and functions.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

[Read More about Market Sizing and Forecasting][48]
[Market Sizing and Forecasting]

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]
[Competitive intelligence illustration showing business analytics]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

#### How long will it take to receive my order?

95% of all orders are handed over to our shipping & logistics partners the very next working day
(within 24 hrs). Custom printed orders take an additional 3 days for artwork approval and CTP/plate
making. Majority of our orders are delivered within 2 days after shipment via Blue Dart, Delhivery,
India Post, etc. Remote locations and ones affected by lockdown may take longer.

#### What is your price for a bulk quantity order?

Please e-mail your request to sales@upack.in and we will be happy to provide a bulk quotation for
packaging materials, customised boxes, carton boxes, packing tapes, bubble roll, stretch film, etc.

#### Can you sell to individual customers or just to companies?

Although most of our sales are business to business, we can sell to any type of customer.

#### What other payment options?

You may use all major credit cards, net banking, UPI, etc. U-Pack’s payment gateway partners are
PCI/DSS certified to keep your transaction details confidential at all times.
